title: Comparison of independent results
$comment: DRAFT. Frozen as schema v1 only at T1's gate (PLAN.md section 7). Uses the keyword subset implemented by tools/validate.py; an unknown keyword is an error there, never ignored.
description: Ranks N proposals that were each evaluated on their own. It cites results by digest and never restates their numbers, so a result stays about one proposal and stays independently checkable: a checker re-verifies each result, then re-derives this ranking from them. Only results sharing an objective, domain, baseline and valuation time may be compared, and those shared terms are repeated here so a checker can confirm it without opening the results.

shared.description: The terms every candidate must agree on for the ranking to mean anything.

ranked_by.description: Only passing candidates are ranked, cheapest first. A candidate that fails or needs review has no place in an ordering by cost, because its cost bought something the model has not established.

ranking.description: Labels of passing candidates, cheapest first. Absent when none passes.
